(e.g., if h was a linear classifier, then f is also a linear classifier). Statement 2| Cross validation can be used to select the number of iterations in boosting; this procedure may help reduce overfitting.

Options: 
A. The statement 1 is not clear, True
B. False, False
C. True, Statement 2 is not clear
D. False, Both are not related
E. True, False
F. True, True
G. Both statements are not clear
H. False, True
I. True, Cross validation is not needed
J. False, Cross validation increases overfitting

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.

"Cross validation can be used to select the number of iterations in boosting; this procedure may help reduce overfitting."

*   Cross validation (or Leave-One-Out if data is small) is the standard method to tune this parameter to minimize validation error.
